name: task_handoff_without_tool
about: An agent author lists a handoff in a task but gives the agent no tool of that name. Building the agent fails with a message that names the task and the handoff, before any call.
instructions: You help callers with their orders.

tasks.name: take_note
tasks.when: The caller wants to leave a note.

expect.build_error: task 'take_note' lists the handoff 'to_nowhere', which the agent has no tool for.
